_comment: Wheel-source freshness fingerprint (DEC-BRUTEX-LAKE-BOX-WHEEL-001; the fno_math/trading_core R2-CC-G1 pattern, the brutex_feed file is the template). The crate version + sorted compiled-symbol surface the CURRENT source tree is expected to expose; pinned equal to sorted(brutex_lake.__all__) by tests (the lake shim deliberately carries no _EXPECTED_COMPILED_SYMBOLS constant — __all__ is the one in-code surface list). Update this file in the SAME commit as any rust/brutex-lake surface or version change. Consumed by the `brutex doctor` stage `wheel_freshness_brutex_lake`. HONEST envelope (Golden Rule #10): version + symbol-set checks catch a stale wheel that dropped/added a symbol or changed crate version — nearly toothless alone for this crate (the version is frozen at 0.1.0); same-version symbol-compatible BEHAVIORAL drift is caught by the sibling `wheel_source_digest_brutex_lake` stage comparing the build.rs-baked `__source_digest__` (FRAMING v1, DEC-RUST-SOURCE-DIGEST-TWIN-001) against the repo crate tree. A digest match still does NOT prove polars lockstep — a fresh wheel can be latched OFF by the facades' own polars version guard (their loud WARN, out of doctor scope).
